def p_sample(LT,top,b,T=0.6,pp=1.5,topk=20,topp=0.95):
    lt=(LT+b)/T; lo=(top-pp)/T   # (n,25)
    allv=np.concatenate([lt[:,None],lo],1)
    # top-k
    srt=-np.sort(-allv,axis=1)[:,:topk]

    cs=np.cumsum(pr,1); kmass=np.array([cs[i,min(np.searchsorted(cs[i],topp),topk-1)] for i in range(len(cs))])
